memory_candidates.title: A loop-checking guard that ADDS a redirect edge manufactures a soundness obligation the source calculus does not have
memory_candidates.body: Massacci2000 Technique 8.2 blocks by withholding the pi-rule and adding nothing, which is why its loop-checking theorem (Thm 8.1) is completeness-side only. A driver that instead records the redirect in the same accessibility structure the soundness invariant quantifies over turns a completeness-side model-construction artifact into a per-step soundness obligation, typically unprovable against an existentially arbitrary witness model. The fix is to split the bookkeeping: a soundness-tracked structure holding only justified edges, plus a completeness-only channel. General principle: an artifact needed only by the model-construction direction must not live in a structure the soundness invariant reads.

memory_candidates.title: Relocating an obligation from per-step to terminal-state can convert a FALSE lemma into a true one
memory_candidates.body: Counterexamples to per-step invariant preservation in saturating tableau drivers are frequently transient: the branch is repaired one step later. The same statement restricted to terminal saturated branches can hold. Before abandoning a route because a lemma was refuted, check at which state the counterexample lives. Measured instance: blockedRedirect_boxctx_mem was refuted at step 6 of a 5-step trace, yet its conclusion holds with 0 failures over 24,314 recorded blocking decisions at terminal open leaves.

memory_candidates.title: Weakening a branch invariant can make its frame-condition requirements STRONGER
memory_candidates.body: In CSLib's modal tableau line the full-strength branchSatisfiableIn 4-rule lemmas need IsTrans only (FrameSoundness.lean:1085-1100, :1106-1123: hrefl is destructured and never used) and the K box-positive lemma needs no frame condition at all (SoundnessStep.lean:446-459 has no FC parameter). The weakened branchPropAdequateIn line by contrast needs Std.Refl (:1454) plus an hready side hypothesis (:1449-1450), because the weak edge conjunct delivers box-phi at the target rather than an edge. Consequence: weakening the invariant blocks reuse by non-reflexive transitive corners (K4/K45/D4/D45), while full strength does not.

memory_candidates.title: When auditing a decision procedure's differential, build an independent semantic oracle and prove the feature under test actually fires
memory_candidates.body: A direct Bool evaluator over all reflexive-transitive frames up to size 3-4 is about 40 lines, calibrates against a known countermodel from a docstring, and upgrades 'the verdict changed on N formulas' into 'the driver was unsound on N1 and lost completeness on N2'. Equally important: verify the feature under test actually triggers on the corpus, since verdict agreement over a corpus where the guard never fires is worthless. An exact classifier is often available from the implementation's own shape: a blocked step is the unique case where acc.edges grows while keys.length does not.
